entities.name: Sabul Hajeen
entities.description: Human Civic Guildmage of Zhalfir who summoned the angel Kotara to avenge his brother.

entities.name: Kotara
entities.description: Angel summoned by Sabul who was corrupted by his vengeance and died saving him.

entities.name: Axdan Hajeen
entities.description: Sabul's young brother, murdered in an alley.

entities.name: Multam Ilmiera
entities.description: Murderer of Axdan, killed by Kotara.

entities.name: Yirtag Ilmiera
entities.description: Multam's cousin killed slowly by Kotara.

entities.name: Eskander Ilmiera
entities.description: Relative of the killer who fell to Kotara.

entities.name: Otori Ilmiera
entities.description: Relative of the killer who fell to Kotara.

entities.name: Ferren Tynlo
entities.description: Man not of the Ilmiera family whom Kotara refused to kill.

entities.name: Tartesk Hajeen
entities.description: Sabul's uncle who summoned a Hand of Justice.

entities.name: Hand of Justice
entities.description: Avatar summoned to stop crime that began targeting the poor.

entities.name: Jhossendea Ilmiera
entities.description: Necromancer, arch-enemy of Hajeen family who allied with Sabul.

events.summary: Sabul summons Kotara and sends her to kill Multam Ilmiera, his brother's murderer.
events.quote: Sabul sent Kotara out to kill the murderer

events.summary: Sabul has Kotara kill the murderer's relatives, corrupting her.
events.quote: These evil acts started affecting Kotara

events.summary: Kotara abandons her mission to kill Ferren Tynlo and returns to Sabul.
events.quote: Kotara abandoned her mission and returned to Sabul

events.summary: Kotara dies wounding a demon so Sabul can exile it.
Sabul allies with Jhossendea Ilmiera to banish the Hand of Justice.
events.quote: managed to banish the Hand of Justice

relations.note: Allied against the Hand of Justice
relations.quote: Together, the two of them managed to banish the Hand of Justice
